description: A Fabled Faun is a mysterious woodland creature, known for its gentle nature and deep connection to the magic of the forest. Its upper body resembles that of a humanoid, with curling horns and a mane of leaves and flowers, while its lower half is that of a nimble deer. Fabled Fauns are often seen dancing under moonlight and are revered by woodland creatures as protectors of nature.
damage_resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from Nonmagical Attacks

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: The Fabled Faun has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The Fabled Faun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Hoof Kick
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Call of the Wild
actions.description: The Fabled Faun can magically summon 1d4 fey creatures (sprites, pixies, or other woodland beings). These creatures act as allies to the Faun.
